current_primary_source_revalidation.repo_readme: AgentSight still describes system-boundary correlation of LLM traffic with process/file/network/resource activity and live eBPF capture.
current_primary_source_revalidation.privilege_boundary: Current README says live eBPF probes need root/sudo or corresponding BPF/admin capability; Docker still needs privileged host access.
current_primary_source_revalidation.storage_boundary: Recorded sessions are written to agentsight-*.db SQLite files; any F2 use must remain foreign witness evidence and must not become a competing canonical truth store.
current_primary_source_revalidation.capture_boundary: Current docs still distinguish eBPF/live capture from agent-native/offline session paths; provenance class must remain explicit.
current_primary_source_revalidation.paper_boundary: The PACMI/arXiv work reports <3% overhead upstream, but this invocation did not reproduce that result for F2.

repair_recommendation.planner_rule: Before create-only claiming, resolve objective occupancy across claims + research deltas + reconciliation receipts + Trigger-4 research inbox + pending_research.sqlite when available, and compare exact upstream/source pin.
repair_recommendation.legacy_rule: If legacy evidence already covers the same source pin and evidence objective, do not mint a new E1/E2 objective merely because its claim file is absent.
repair_recommendation.review_rule: Create an explicit E2_REVIEW_<architecture_delta_id> or E1_REVIEW_<source_delta_id> only when a concrete architecture/source delta makes re-review informative.

next_exact_action: Trigger-4/Trigger-6 coordination should add or enforce a pre-claim objective-availability resolver that treats the claim directory as a mutex surface, not as a complete work-history index.
